verdict.rationale: Fellow documents in-product AI output for every meeting: summaries, suggested AI action items, decisions, and topic-based minutes (fellow-docs-23, fellow-docs-51, fellow-docs-52). The pricing page also lists 'Ask Fellow' (fellow-docs-53), though it is only named there. The MCP and API evidence describes external AI tools rather than insights inside the product, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: documented detail on in-product Q&A or insights across meetings (Ask Fellow is only a pricing line item), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the quality of the AI insights.
